info.title: Beadhive Host Operator API
info.description: Authenticated host operator and activity API. Health is the sole public route; every other operation declares an independent bearer scope.

x-beadhive-secure-network-preflight.pathScope: all request paths, including paths absent from this document

get.summary: Read the authoritative registered hive directory
get.description: Returns the exact authenticated FactoryResponse without workspace paths, worktree paths, or credentials.

200.description: Current factory directory and daemon status

options.summary: Authorize a credentialed factory read preflight

204.description: The exact allowed Origin may issue the requested GET

get.summary: Read bounded generic summaries for registered hives
get.description: Returns canonical registry identity and source-derived aggregate counts. Ordering is lexical by canonical hive id. An unavailable hive remains present with null counts; an available empty hive has zero counts. open counts literal status=open records; ready is the subset with no known unresolved prerequisite or open gate; active counts status=in_progress; blocked combines status=blocked with open issues that have a known unresolved prerequisite. ready and blocked are subsets that may overlap the open category.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque snapshot-scoped cursor returned by nextCursor.

200.description: One bounded deterministic page of hive summaries

304.description: The selected page still matches If-None-Match

get.summary: Read one exact canonical hive snapshot
get.description: The provider/organization/repository identity uses one uppercase percent-encoded representation; slash separators are %2F. The returned snapshot and cursor are installed atomically.

parameters.name: hive_id
parameters.description: Full canonical provider/organization/repository identity, with separators encoded as uppercase %2F.

get.summary: Read one bounded generic work-item queue
get.description: Returns a snapshot-stable page from the ready, active, blocked, or recently completed queue. Cursors are opaque and scoped to the exact hive, queue, filters, ordering, and source revision.

parameters.name: hive_id
parameters.description: Full canonical provider/organization/repository identity, with separators encoded as uppercase %2F.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned by the preceding page.

parameters.name: priority
parameters.description: Repeat to select any of the supplied priorities.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: Repeat to require every supplied label.

304.description: The selected page has not changed

get.description: Returns complete generic issue facts for one exact canonical hive and bead identity. It never resolves a prefix, title, or current-directory inference.

parameters.name: hive_id
parameters.description: Full canonical provider/organization/repository identity, with separators encoded as uppercase %2F.

304.description: The exact detail has not changed

get.summary: Follow one exact canonical hive event stream
get.description: Returns only operator-event SSE frames strictly after the supplied snapshot cursor. after is normative; cursor is a temporary compatibility alias. If multiple cursor sources are present, their values must be byte-identical.

parameters.name: hive_id
parameters.description: Full canonical provider/organization/repository identity, with separators encoded as uppercase %2F.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Normative snapshot or SSE cursor producerEpoch:sequence, with an 85-byte maximum.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Temporary compatibility alias for after, with the same 85-byte maximum.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: Resumable SSE cursor producerEpoch:sequence, with an 85-byte maximum.

options.summary: Authorize the exact local Last-Event-ID SSE preflight

204.description: The exact allowed Origin may issue GET with Last-Event-ID

get.summary: Read activity for one exact outer run
get.description: The activity producer epoch and sequence are independent of the journal source revision. A missing source is never returned as authoritative empty activity.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Return a delta strictly after producerEpoch:sequence.

410.description: The cursor producer epoch is no longer retained

post.summary: Durably publish activity for one exact outer run
post.description: The path run ID is authoritative. The authenticated credential principal is service:<source>:<seat>; source and any payload provenance fields must agree with that principal and the exact run journal. A created response follows durable commit and installation into the exact-run read feed; a duplicate response identifies the same previously committed activity.

200.description: Byte-identical retry of a previously committed activity

BearerAuth.description: Opaque bearer credential. Each operation declares its required scope.

Unauthorized.description: A valid bearer credential with the operation's required scope is required

NotFound.description: Exact hive, run, or source does not exist

Forbidden.description: The client peer or Origin is outside the local phase-one profile

ReadOnly.description: After authentication, the requested mutation is not part of the enabled product surface; secure-network preflight OPTIONS is handled before route dispatch

Resnapshot.description: The client must fetch a replacement hive snapshot before reconnecting

Unavailable.description: An authoritative local source could not answer, or the authenticated daemon is draining

RequestTimeout.description: The bounded secure-network request body read timed out

PayloadTooLarge.description: The request body exceeded the configured secure-network bound

RateLimited.description: The normalized bearer credential exceeded its configured request rate

payload.description: Source-specific activity. Optional seat and writer values are assertions checked against authenticated-principal and exact-journal authority; they do not establish provenance.
